title: DslExpressionUpdatedPayload
description: Event payload emitted by the Dsl.Expression.Update handler after a successful save. The artifact storage IS the projection per ADR 0007 §3 — this event drives audit + cache invalidation; no projection rebuild reads it.

artifactId.description: Server-minted UUID. Stable across all versions of this (tenantId, apiName) artifact.

version.description: Monotonic; 1 on first save, +1 per subsequent save.

outcome.description: `inserted` for the first save (version=1); `versioned` for every save after.
